title: Operation Paperclip scientists in the childhood neighbourhood

tellings.quote: Operation Paperclip people apparently lived in my neighborhood.

plain: In the 1950s, scientists brought to America under Operation Paperclip, the postwar programme that recruited German scientists, lived in the Terrell Hills neighbourhood of San Antonio, Texas, where he grew up. The writer Whitley Strieber tells Michels this, saying such people "apparently lived in my neighborhood," and credits the author Peter Levenda as the source.
